title: Judge Gift Cards 1998: card flavor text

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: An experimenter who designed a silver golem after a portal experiment succeeded.

entities.name: Gamelen
entities.description: A Citanul elder who speaks of the first seedling of Argoth.

entities.name: Citanul
entities.description: A group of druids whose elder Gamelen speaks of Argoth.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: Land where the first seedling sprouted and where the last tree will fall.

events.summary: After a hundred failed experiments, Urza finds silver passes through the portal undamaged and designs a silver golem.
events.quote: He immediately designed a golem made of the metal.
